import sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'.git/research-python')
import z3
P=[(0,0),(1,1),(2,0),(3,1),(2,2),(5,4),(6,5),(7,3),(8,7),(9,4),(10,9)]
t=time.perf_counter();s=z3.SolverFor('QF_BV');s.set(timeout=60000,random_seed=0)
caps=[z3.BitVec('c'+str(i),7) for i in range(11)]
s.add(z3.Sum([z3.ZeroExt(4,c) for c in caps])==108)
B=[z3.BitVecVal(1,109)];L=[]
for i,(p,q) in enumerate(P,1):
 a,b=z3.BitVecs('a'+str(i)+' b'+str(i),7);L.append((a,b))
 s.add(z3.ULE(a,caps[p]),z3.ULE(b,caps[q]))
 if p==q:s.add(z3.UGT(a,b))
 x,y=B[p]<<z3.ZeroExt(102,a),B[q]<<z3.ZeroExt(102,b)
 s.add(x&y==0)
 v=z3.BitVec('v'+str(i),109);s.add(v==x|y);B.append(v)
s.add(B[-1]==(1<<109)-1)
print('built',flush=True);r=s.check();print(r,s.reason_unknown(),time.perf_counter()-t,flush=True)
if r==z3.sat:print(s.model())
